title: 读懂化学品安全信息

author_source: project/ACS College Lab Safety Series/02_Chemical Safety Information Resources ACS College Safety Video 2/src.py

points.K1: 防护装备按风险评估来选
points.K5: 第1部分：认准是哪种化学品
points.K9: 第4部分：急救与进入途径
points.K12: 第10部分：不相容物与废液
points.K19: 资料讲危害，风险靠评估
points.S4: 管制化学品与本校平台

shots.scene: 欣欣穿实验服、戴护目镜，手捧一份空白的说明书，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot in a lab coat and safety goggles holds a thick blank data sheet booklet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲怎么读懂化学品安全信息。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶、说明书、放大镜三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a reagent bottle with a blank label, a blank data sheet, and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 用之前先查清：它有什么危害？

shots.scene: 阿杰从柜里拿出一瓶贴空白标签的试剂，准备直接开盖
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a lab coat takes a reagent bottle with a blank label from a cabinet and reaches to open the cap.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿到一瓶没用过的试剂，就想开盖。

shots.scene: 小研按住瓶盖，递给他一份空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently stops his hand and hands him a blank data sheet booklet.
shots.narration: 小研说：先看看它的安全技术说明书。

shots.scene: 阿杰翻开厚厚的说明书，满脸茫然
shots.prompt_en: The young male student flips open the thick blank booklet and looks confused.
shots.narration: 可这么多页，该从哪儿看起？

shots.section_title: 防护装备按风险评估来选
shots.scene: 王老师对照空白评估表，给学生分发护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank assessment form and hands out safety goggles and gloves to students.
shots.narration: 穿戴什么防护，是按风险评估选的。
overlay: 防护装备按风险评估来选

shots.section_title: 防护装备按风险评估来选
shots.scene: 撤空试剂的讲解台
shots.prompt_en: A clean demonstration bench with no reagent bottles on it, only a blank whiteboard behind. No people.
shots.narration: 不穿防护讲课的地方，化学品要撤走。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着放大镜对着试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks at a reagent bottle through a large magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 识别危害，是设计安全实验的基础。

shots.scene: 四个图标中第一个放大镜亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row; the first one, a magnifying glass, lights up brightly. No people.
shots.narration: 它是识别、评估、降低、准备的第一步。

shots.scene: 清单上每一项都打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with every line getting a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 每个实验的危害，都要先一一找出来。

shots.scene: 小研在桌前翻阅空白资料
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads blank printed documents at a desk.
shots.narration: 这一课学用书面资料识别化学品危害。

shots.scene: 高压、低温、高温、电气四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a pressure gauge, a snowflake, a flame thermometer, and a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 高压、低温高温、用电，也都有危害。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a reagent bottle on the bench.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们先聚焦化学品。

shots.scene: 试剂箱里附着一份空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: A chemical shipping box with a reagent bottle and a blank data sheet booklet tucked beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品生产商，要随货提供说明书。

shots.scene: 地球图标和统一格式的文件图标
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon next to a stack of identical blank document icons. No people.
shots.narration: 它按全球统一的分类和标签制度编写。

shots.scene: 欣欣把说明书放在路线图的第一站
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot places a blank data sheet at the first stop of a simple route map.
shots.narration: 了解危害，第一站就查它。

shots.scene: 十六格的目录图标，其中七格高亮
shots.prompt_en: A grid of sixteen blank boxes with seven of them highlighted in yellow. No people.
shots.narration: 统一16个部分，先看和危害有关的7个。

shots.section_title: 第1部分：认准是哪种化学品
shots.scene: 说明书第一页，顶部一个身份证图标
shots.prompt_en: The first page of a blank data sheet with an ID card icon at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 第1部分：先确认是不是这种化学品。
overlay: 第1部分：认准是哪种化学品

shots.section_title: 第1部分：认准是哪种化学品
shots.scene: 一个瓶子图标连着三个不同的名字气泡
shots.prompt_en: A bottle icon connected to three blank name tags with arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 同一种物质，常常有好几个名字。

shots.section_title: 第1部分：认准是哪种化学品
shots.scene: 两只瓶子，一浓一稀，中间不等号
shots.prompt_en: Two bottles side by side, one dark and concentrated, one pale and diluted, with a not-equal sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 浓度也要对上，浓的不能查稀的。

shots.section_title: 第1部分：认准是哪种化学品
shots.scene: 瓶身编号和说明书编号用线连上，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle label with a blank number box linked by a line to a matching number box on a data sheet, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 每种化学品有唯一的CAS号。

shots.section_title: 第1部分：认准是哪种化学品
shots.scene: 小研拿着瓶子和说明书逐项核对
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a reagent bottle and a data sheet side by side, comparing them carefully.
shots.narration: 瓶上的名称和编号，必须和说明书一致。

shots.scene: 说明书第2页，一列空白横线旁有警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A blank data sheet page with a column of blank lines and a yellow warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第2部分：危险性概述。

shots.scene: 长长的清单中只有几行被高亮
shots.prompt_en: A long blank list with only three lines highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 统一的危险说明，一种化学品只占几条。

shots.scene: 九个红框菱形象形图排成阵列
shots.prompt_en: Nine red-bordered diamond hazard pictograms arranged in a grid: skull, flame, flame over circle, exploding bomb, corrosion, gas cylinder, health hazard, exclamation mark, environment. No people.
shots.narration: 象形图一共九种，每种代表一类危害。

shots.scene: 一个瓶子上只贴了一两个象形图
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with only one or two diamond pictograms on its blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 多数化学品，只有一两个象形图。

shots.scene: 乙醚瓶上三个象形图：火焰、感叹号、健康危害
shots.prompt_en: A bottle with a blank label showing three pictograms: a flame, an exclamation mark, and a health hazard silhouette. No people.
shots.narration: 乙醚有三个：易燃、刺激、健康危害。

shots.scene: 不同国家的人看着同一个象形图点头
shots.prompt_en: Several simple person pictograms with different speech bubble symbols all nod at the same flame pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 不管说什么语言，一眼就能认出来。

shots.scene: 两个信号词卡片，一深红一橙黄
shots.prompt_en: Two blank word cards, one dark red and one amber, side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 信号词有两个：危险和警告。

shots.scene: 危害程度刻度上两个指针
shots.prompt_en: A hazard scale bar with a dark red marker near the top and an amber marker lower. No people.
shots.narration: 它粗略表示危害的相对程度。

shots.scene: 一长串打勾的防范说明清单
shots.prompt_en: A long blank checklist of precautions with small icons of goggles, gloves and a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 防范说明，告诉你怎么安全使用。

shots.section_title: 第4部分：急救与进入途径
shots.scene: 说明书第4页，带红十字图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank data sheet page with a red cross first aid icon at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 第4部分：急救措施。
overlay: 第4部分：急救与进入途径

shots.section_title: 第4部分：急救与进入途径
shots.scene: 人体轮廓上标出眼、鼻、口、皮肤四处
shots.prompt_en: A simple human body outline with arrows pointing to the eyes, nose, mouth and skin. No people.
shots.narration: 按每种进入途径，分别给出急救方法。

shots.section_title: 第4部分：急救与进入途径
shots.scene: 小研指着人体图思考
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the body outline poster and thinks.
shots.narration: 想化学品会怎么伤人，先想这几条路。

shots.scene: 说明书第8页，配防护和通风图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank data sheet page with goggles and a ventilation fan icon at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 第8部分：接触控制和个体防护。

shots.scene: 时钟和平均线图标
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon next to a wavy line with a flat average line through it. No people.
shots.narration: 这里有时间加权平均、容许接触限值。

shots.scene: 两根柱子，矮柱旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Two bars side by side, a very short bar with a red warning triangle and a tall bar with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 限值越低，吸入危害越严重。

shots.scene: 一氧化碳与乙醇两个分子图标，矮柱一侧更醒目
shots.prompt_en: Two simple molecule icons above the two bars; the one above the short bar glows red. No people.
shots.narration: 一氧化碳限值远低于乙醇，要更小心。

shots.scene: 说明书第9页，配温度计图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank data sheet page with a thermometer icon at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 第9部分：理化特性。

shots.scene: 温度计和火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon and a small flame icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 沸点和闪点，用来判断易不易燃。

shots.scene: 常温下烧杯冒出蒸气，远处火源打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A beaker at room temperature with vapor drifting toward a distant flame icon, which is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 乙醚闪点很低，室温下蒸气就能点着。

shots.section_title: 第10部分：不相容物与废液
shots.scene: 说明书第10页，配两个互斥箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank data sheet page with two opposing arrows icon at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 第10部分：稳定性和反应性。
overlay: 第10部分：不相容物与废液

shots.section_title: 第10部分：不相容物与废液
shots.scene: 一瓶带氧化象形图的瓶子旁边，一长串被划掉的小瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A bottle with an oxidizer pictogram beside a long column of small bottle icons, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 这里列出不能放在一起的物质。

shots.section_title: 第10部分：不相容物与废液
shots.scene: 两种液体倒进同一个废液桶，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two different liquids being poured into the same waste container, with a red X over it. No people.
shots.narration: 很多事故，是把不相容的倒进同一废液瓶。

shots.section_title: 第10部分：不相容物与废液
shots.scene: 乙醚瓶与氧化剂瓶之间一道隔板
shots.prompt_en: A flammable liquid bottle and an oxidizer bottle separated by a divider wall with a red no-mixing symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 乙醚不能和氧化剂、强酸混在一起。

shots.scene: 说明书第11页，配骷髅象形图
shots.prompt_en: A blank data sheet page with a skull pictogram at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 第11部分：毒理学信息。

shots.scene: S形曲线图，一半处有虚线
shots.prompt_en: A simple S-shaped dose response curve with a dashed line at the halfway point. No people.
shots.narration: 半数致死量，是让一半受试动物死亡的量。

shots.scene: 短时钟和长日历两个图标
shots.prompt_en: A stopwatch icon labeled with a short arrow and a calendar icon with a long arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 毒性分急性和慢性两类。

shots.scene: 瓶口蒸气飘向一个犯困的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Vapor from a bottle drifting toward a person pictogram with dizzy swirl lines, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室主要防急性：乙醚会致头晕嗜睡。

shots.scene: 老周讲起旧事，背景是一张老式病床图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man tells a story, a thought bubble beside him shows a simple old hospital bed icon.
shots.narration: 它过去还被当作手术麻醉剂。

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着说明书，眉头微皱
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank data sheet and frowns slightly.
shots.narration: 说明书很有用，但不是万能的。

shots.scene: 说明书分发给工人、司机、实验员三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A data sheet icon with arrows to three person pictograms: a factory worker, a truck driver and a lab worker. No people.
shots.narration: 它写给很多人看，有些内容和实验室无关。

shots.scene: 说明书上一排空白格子带问号
shots.prompt_en: A blank data sheet with a column of empty boxes, each marked with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 看到“无可用数据”，要格外小心。

shots.scene: 一大堆瓶子，只有少数打了勾
shots.prompt_en: A huge pile of bottle icons where only a few have green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品成千上万，测过毒性的只是少数。

shots.scene: 编写者漏填的空格图标
shots.prompt_en: A form icon with one blank box and a pencil lying beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 也可能是编写者没写进去。

shots.scene: “无数据”等于“安全”的等式被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An equation of a question mark box equals a green shield, crossed out with a big red X. No people.
shots.narration: 无数据，绝不等于安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head seriously.
shots.narration: 只是不知道，或者没人查过。

shots.scene: 一个气瓶图标旁的熔点格子被划掉
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder icon beside a melting thermometer icon that is greyed out. No people.
shots.narration: “不适用”，是这项性质对它没意义。

shots.scene: N/A卡片分成两个方向的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A blank card splitting into two arrows pointing to two different blank boxes. No people.
shots.narration: N/A可能是不适用，也可能是查不到。

shots.scene: 说明书上有红圈标出的错误
shots.prompt_en: A blank data sheet with two red circles marking errors and a missing corner. No people.
shots.narration: 说明书也会有错误和遗漏。

shots.scene: 两份不同的说明书并排，内容不一样
shots.prompt_en: Two blank data sheets side by side with different shapes of highlighted lines. No people.
shots.narration: 同一化学品，不同厂家写的可能不一样。

shots.scene: 一句空泛的话气泡，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: A vague speech bubble with a scribble inside next to a large question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 有的话没错，却帮不上忙。

shots.scene: 小研拿两份说明书对照核对
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares two blank data sheets side by side with a pen.
shots.narration: 所以要多方核对，不要只信一份。

shots.scene: 电脑屏幕上空白的化学品数据库页面
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen showing a blank chemical database page with a flask icon. No people.
shots.narration: 查不到时，还可以查化学品安全数据库。

shots.scene: 多个来源箭头汇到一页
shots.prompt_en: Several document icons with arrows merging into one summary page. No people.
shots.narration: 有的数据库汇总了多个来源的信息。

shots.scene: 四色菱形，四个格子空白
shots.prompt_en: A fire diamond divided into four colored squares: red top, blue left, yellow right, white bottom, all blank. No people.
shots.narration: 国外资料上常见四色菱形标识。

shots.scene: 刻度0到4的条形，从绿到红
shots.prompt_en: A scale bar from 0 to 4 shading from green to red. No people.
shots.narration: 数字0到4，越大越危险。

shots.section_title: 资料讲危害，风险靠评估
shots.scene: 说明书和风险表之间一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A blank data sheet on the left, a gauge meter on the right, and a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 资料只告诉你危害，不替你评估风险。
overlay: 资料讲危害，风险靠评估

shots.section_title: 资料讲危害，风险靠评估
shots.scene: 大瓶危险试剂只取一小滴，风险表指向低
shots.prompt_en: A large bottle with a warning pictogram and a single small drop in a dish beside it, with a gauge reading low. No people.
shots.narration: 用量少、方法对，高危化学品风险也低。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴眼镜认真读说明书，拿笔圈画
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears reading glasses and studies a blank data sheet, circling items with a pen.
shots.narration: 识别危害，是风险管理的重要一环。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰一起读说明书，阿杰点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student read a data sheet together; he nods with understanding.
shots.narration: 学会带着问题读，合理防护安全用。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶上贴着安全标签，旁边一份说明书
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a safety label showing pictograms and blank lines, next to a blank data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 国内要求化学品“一书一签”。

shots.scene: 一摞空白标准文本图标
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank standard booklets with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 分类和标签按GB 30000系列。

shots.scene: 标签分区：象形图、信号词、说明各一块
shots.prompt_en: A large safety label diagram divided into zones: a pictogram zone, a word zone, and blank text zones. No people.
shots.narration: 标签上有象形图、信号词和防范说明。

shots.scene: 实验室墙上的文件夹里放着说明书
shots.prompt_en: A wall-mounted file holder in a lab containing blank data sheet booklets. No people.
shots.narration: 说明书要放在实验室里随手可查。

shots.scene: 空白的国家标准文本，旁边时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank national standard booklet next to a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 国内职业接触限值，看GBZ 2.1。

shots.scene: 三张术语卡片
shots.prompt_en: Three blank term cards in a row with small clock and peak icons. No people.
shots.narration: 术语和数值以现行国家标准为准。

shots.scene: 说明书上国外电话被划掉，换成119、120
shots.prompt_en: A data sheet corner with a blank foreign phone box crossed out, replaced by a telephone icon with fire and red cross icons. No people.
shots.narration: 国外应急电话不适用，打119和120。

shots.scene: 阿杰向王老师报告，小研带着说明书
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the safety administrator while the female graduate student holds a blank data sheet.
shots.narration: 立即报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 救护车图标和说明书
shots.prompt_en: An ambulance icon with a blank data sheet beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 就医时带上说明书，方便医生处置。

shots.section_title: 管制化学品与本校平台
shots.scene: 带锁的柜子和三种标记图标
shots.prompt_en: A locked chemical cabinet with three small blank tag icons on its door. No people.
shots.narration: 剧毒、易制毒、易制爆化学品要管控。
overlay: 管制化学品与本校平台

shots.section_title: 管制化学品与本校平台
shots.scene: 王老师在电脑前查看空白的化学品管理平台
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank chemical management system on a computer screen.
shots.narration: 购买领用要登记，以本校规定为准。

shots.section_title: 管制化学品与本校平台
shots.scene: 空白目录书本图标
shots.prompt_en: A thick blank catalog book icon with a bookmark. No people.
shots.narration: 查《危险化学品目录》和本校平台。

shots.scene: 几个分类废液桶，贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: Several waste containers lined up, each with a different color blank label and pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 废液按性质分类收集，不相容不混装。

shots.scene: 水槽下水道图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A sink drain icon with liquid pouring into it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 危险废液，不能倒进下水道。

shots.scene: 废液桶贴标签，交给收运车
shots.prompt_en: A labeled waste container being handed over to a collection cart. No people.
shots.narration: 贴好标签，交学校统一处置。

shots.scene: 小研给自配溶液瓶贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sticks a blank label onto a bottle of a solution she just prepared.
shots.narration: 自己配的溶液、分装的试剂也要贴标签。

shots.scene: 没有标签的瓶子打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An unlabeled bottle on a shelf, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没有标签的瓶子，谁也说不清是什么。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现说明书和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a data sheet and a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 用化学品，先查说明书和标签。

shots.scene: 名字、CAS号、浓度三项打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three checked boxes with icons of a name tag, a number tag and a concentration flask. No people.
shots.narration: 名称、编号、浓度，逐项核对。

shots.scene: 象形图、信号词、急救、限值、闪点、不相容、毒性图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a diamond pictogram, a word card, a red cross, a clock, a flame thermometer, crossed arrows, and a skull. No people.
shots.narration: 重点看危害、急救、限值、闪点和毒性。

shots.scene: 无数据问号框被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A question mark box with a red X over a green shield. No people.
shots.narration: 无数据不等于安全，资料要多方核对。

shots.scene: 风险表和评估表
shots.prompt_en: A gauge meter and a blank assessment form with a check. No people.
shots.narration: 资料讲危害，风险还要自己评估。

shots.scene: 欣欣合上说明书，向镜头挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot closes a blank data sheet booklet and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 先查清，再动手，下次见！
